query_family: can't cancel a subscription; cancel a gym membership, AT&T service, alarm monitoring, or a streaming subscription
hypothesis: A biller-first planner with conditional federal, state and local examples, editable cancellation scripts, proof steps, and official escalation links may earn Google clicks from consumers who cannot complete a cancellation. No traffic or outcome increase is assumed.
baseline_reason: No verified pre-change GSC extract exists for this query family. The 2026-10-29 baseline review found no current route-level baseline or comparator; the available GA4 pull had zero matching rows.
prior_specification: not-yet-published; use an age-matched cohort of relevant checklist and guide pages, with query-family GSC data recorded after launch
comparator_plan: Age-match against relevant 2026-10 checklist and guide pages after the first complete 28-day live window; report impressions, clicks, and CTR without attributing causality from a small cohort.
change_scope: new route with an added checklist-hub card and three contextual inbound links
source_refresh_trigger: A change to the cited federal rule, statute, court ruling, agency guidance, or listed provider cancellation instructions.

windows.day28: first 28 complete live days after verified deployment

production_cost.scope: Recorded estimate for the writer call only; research, review, implementation, and other generation costs were not fully itemized.

trend_signal_note: The brief cited 5,270 posts and an October 28 level about 1.8 times the usual daily level, but the underlying source/export was unavailable. These figures and the unsupported awareness claim were excluded from the page.
